versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

Initial public release of alibaba-quark-scan-free.

- Provides free, high-quality file scanning with official Quark Scan API.
- Supports three main features: image quality enhancement, handwritten text removal, and document scanning.
- Allows image inputs via URL, local file path, or Base64; supports batch scan and export in various formats.
- Requires API key configuration; images processed on Quark Scan servers.
- Includes error handling for missing input, unsupported formats, size limits, and authentication issues.
- Suitable for everyday image optimization and document digitization for personal users.
